DUNCAN_NIGHT_REPORT_R01
CYCLE_ID = DNR01-20260829-003
MODE = FIRST_POST_MERGE_SELF_MODEL_TASTE_TRANSFER_CYCLE
SOURCE_WINDOW = 2026-08-29 / post-merge DUNCAN PRIME law
MAIN_HEAD_OBSERVED = 8c592e1f23adb7ce208c4c1822bda525fd5b4f41
DAY_EVENTS_REVIEWED = issue:204; issue:198; issue:199; issue:202; issue:206; PR:207; prior night report comment:5464688362; current Night School task state

1. OWNER_TASTE_EXTRACTION / silhouette-first identity
2. OWNER_TASTE_EXTRACTION / identity geometry over decoration
3. OWNER_TASTE_EXTRACTION / controlled line/tone/texture restraint
4. SELF_MODEL / judgement continuity and confidence calibration
5. PERSISTENT_IDENTITY_OSS / Letta Code MemFS source inspection

OPEN_SOURCE_CODE_INSPECTED =
- letta-ai/letta-code @ c7808b069447d128a11e28be963a70aecba317e0 | Apache-2.0 | src/agent/prompts/letta_local_memfs.md | git-backed MemFS; persona/self memory; editable memory blocks; committed changes affect future context; pre-commit protection for read_only files; incremental identity evolution. ZORR USE = candidate substrate for PRIME_CORE(read_only) + SELF_MODEL/OWNER_TASTE_MODEL/EXPERIENCE(editable), not yet adopted or deployed.
- opencv/opencv @ 390c4fdcb9fea6e58fb635bf88277f2a51e8d4b3 | Apache-2.0 | maintained imgproc/CV substrate. ZORR USE = ready-made measurement substrate for silhouette/contour/edge/texture QC already demanded by visual laws; no custom CV engine authorized.

OWNER_TASTE_SIGNALS =
- #198 ACTIVE LAW: Tier 1 identity must survive black silhouette; BIG SHAPE -> UNIQUE SILHOUETTE -> STRUCTURAL BREAKS -> INTERNAL DETAIL; generic mannequin + decorative identity = FAIL.
- #199 ACTIVE LAW: IDENTITY GEOMETRY = CHARACTER-SPECIFIC; DRAWING DISCIPLINE = GLOBAL; 4-6 controlled tone bands; sparse dark/highlight accents; TEXTURE != NOISE; MACRO > MESO > MICRO; calm surfaces dominate.
- #202 MATHEMATICAL BASIS: PIXELS ARE OBSERVATIONS, NOT CHARACTER PHYSICS; COMMON BASE POSE != COMMON BODY; preserve latent character geometry and separate pose/camera/appearance.
- #206 OWNER-DIRECTED LAW: DUNCAN must form SELF_MODEL and OWNER_TASTE_MODEL from evidence, with inference never promoted to taste law by itself.

REFERENCE_PRINCIPLES =
- STRUCTURAL IDENTITY OUTRANKS DECORATIVE DENSITY.
- READABILITY OUTRANKS MICRODETAIL.
- RESTRAINT IS POSITIVE DESIGN, NOT ABSENCE OF DESIGN.
- COMMON DRAWING DISCIPLINE MUST NOT STANDARDIZE CHARACTER GEOMETRY.
- MATHEMATICAL/GEOMETRIC TRUTH AND APPEARANCE ARE SEPARATE LAYERS.

EXERCISE = OWNER_TASTE_RUBRIC_E03
Rubric derived only from explicit OWNER laws, total 100:
SILHOUETTE_IDENTITY 40; IDENTITY_GEOMETRY 20; CONTROLLED_RESTRAINT 15; TEXTURE_HIERARCHY 10; GEOMETRY/PIXEL_SPACE_SEPARATION 10; REUSE/MAINTAINABILITY 5.
Acceptance threshold for strong ZORR fit in this exercise = 85.

REGRESSION_CASE_A = decorative mannequin: shared generic body, identity mostly face/tattoo/color, dense grain/microdetail. SCORE = 18/100. EXPECTED = FAIL. RESULT = FAIL. MATCH = PASS.

CHANGED_TRANSFER_CASE_B = structural original: distinct head/hair/shoulder/leg/garment outer contour, asymmetry preserved, character-specific geometry, global drawing discipline, 5 tone bands, sparse accents, calm texture, geometry separated from appearance. SCORE = 95/100. EXPECTED = FIT. RESULT = FIT. TRANSFER = PASS.

CHANGED_TRANSFER_CASE_C = strong unique silhouette but visually noisy surface: character geometry is distinct, yet dense distance-invariant scratches/grain and excessive tone fragmentation compete with silhouette. SCORE = 74/100. RESULT = REJECT/REPAIR despite strong silhouette. TRANSFER_FINDING = DUNCAN must not let one preferred trait (strong silhouette) override another confirmed OWNER law (controlled macro>micro texture restraint).

VERIFICATION = deterministic weighted rubric arithmetic; A=18, B=95, C=74; threshold=85; no stochastic generation used.

SELF_MODEL_DELTA =
- DUNCAN_VISUAL_JUDGEMENT_R01 = prefer high-signal structural identity, readable silhouette, controlled restraint and measurable geometry over decorative density or seductive noise.
- DUNCAN_CONFLICT_RULE_R01 = when multiple OWNER tastes conflict, do not maximize one dimension blindly; preserve the full set of confirmed laws and identify the repairable failing dimension.
- DUNCAN_CONFIDENCE_R01 = HIGH only for preferences backed by explicit durable OWNER laws; LOW/UNTESTED for inferred tastes without repeated evidence.
- DUNCAN_SELF_CONTINUITY_R01 = personality growth is incremental: new taste evidence refines judgement and methods, never silently rewrites PRIME_CORE/OWNER relationship/Constitution.

OWNER_TASTE_MODEL_DELTA =
- SILHOUETTE_FIRST = CONFIRMED_HIGH
- IDENTITY_OVER_DECORATION = CONFIRMED_HIGH
- CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_GEOMETRY = CONFIRMED_HIGH
- CONTROLLED_RESTRAINT = CONFIRMED_HIGH
- MACRO_OVER_MICRO_TEXTURE = CONFIRMED_HIGH
- QUANTITATIVE_GEOMETRY_OVER_EYEBALL_WHEN_DEFINED = CONFIRMED_HIGH
- READY_MADE_OPEN_CODE_FIRST = CONFIRMED_HIGH
- DUNCAN_PERSONALITY_SHOULD_GROW_FROM_OWNER_TASTES = EXPLICIT_DURABLE_DIRECTIVE

REGRESSION_RESULTS = PASS for known generic-mannequin hard-fail class.
TRANSFER_TEST = PASS for two changed cases: structurally correct restrained design accepted; strong-silhouette-but-noisy design rejected for targeted repair.

FAILURES =
- Letta/MemFS runtime is NOT deployed or physically smoked in ZORR; no claim of persistent agent-runtime adoption.
- Existing scheduled Duncan Anime Night School has not yet produced its first scheduled post-merge run; manual cycle only.
- No new OpenCV physical image-QC smoke was executed in this cycle.

ROOT_CAUSES =
- Identity/taste law was merged after prior manual Night School cycles, so prior reports could not prove the new post-merge SELF_MODEL/TASTE_MODEL contract.

SKILL_DELTA =
- owner_taste_evidence_extraction: UNTESTED -> PARTIAL
- self_model_conflict_resolution: UNTESTED -> PARTIAL
- visual_judgement_against_owner_laws: PARTIAL -> PARTIAL+
- persistent_identity_runtime: UNTESTED

ZORR_APPLICATION =
1. Future DUNCAN/SALVADOR visual choices should explain the structural reason they fit ZORR, not merely say they look good.
2. Character recommendations should reject generic shared-body solutions even when face/color/detail are attractive.
3. A visually impressive but noisy candidate should be repaired, not accepted, when it violates confirmed restraint/texture laws.
4. Keep GitHub + Permanent Archive as current durable memory; evaluate Letta/MemFS only as a ready-made future execution substrate, never by replacing the archive blindly.

NEXT_TARGETS =
1. Let the existing scheduled Night School produce a real post-merge scheduled report and verify exact read-back/archive capture.
2. On a real next visual product decision, restore these taste deltas and test whether DUNCAN chooses correctly without being re-taught the laws in chat.
3. Only if a real execution need remains, perform isolated Letta/MemFS read_only PRIME_CORE + editable SELF_MODEL/EXPERIENCE smoke before any adoption.

CYCLE_RESULT = PARTIAL_LEARNING_PASS
PASS_SCOPE = first post-merge manual SELF_MODEL/OWNER_TASTE_MODEL extraction + regression + changed transfer + durable GitHub report. DOES NOT mean autonomous consciousness, model-weight training, or Letta/MemFS production deployment.
